title: Desk D-S0 entry generation: the judging run (50-packet pilot, then the registered schedule in batches of 200) that produces judged-1/{mask-key.json,proposals.jsonl} for units RQ-20261026-e535-03/-04
note: Filed 2026-10-26 by lane DESK-18-GEN-REPLAY-S0 (session_014Wuw5ZTBbMDhhYNnn9wGJx). WHAT: the only step between the pre-registered entry-generation units and a result. Units RQ-20261026-e535-01 (harness self-check) and -02 (random-entry null, strategy-own comparator, MEASURED sd and the n it implies) are token-free and dispatchable; -03 (arm 1) and -04 (novelty = new subset) score a JUDGED file that does not exist yet. Driver: scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py (modes selfcheck, baselines, packets, intake, score). BLOCKED ON: the held units PR landing, and RQ-20261026-e535-01 landing with verdict pass (do not spend judging tokens on an uncertified instrument). PROCEDURE (all of it: a lane runs it, it is a manager dispatch with a ceiling). (1) PILOT, nothing scored: python3 scripts/research/desk_gen_replay_driver.py packets --out <scratch> --fetch --seed 20261027 --n 50 (a SEPARATE seed, so no registered cutoff is touched); give each of 50 repo-less Sonnet sessions ONE packet from packets.jsonl plus <scratch>/JUDGE-PROTOCOL.md and nothing else; collect one JSON row each; run the intake mode on the rows; read cost per packet from get_session().usage deltas. NEVER run score on pilot output. The pilot answers two UNMEASURED things: proposals per packet (units -03/-04 declare 0.25 as an assumption) and dollars per packet. Ceiling $3. (2) Re-declare the power blocks of -03/-04 from the measured rate (a power edit; the decision_rule is not touched) in the promotion PR. (3) FULL RUN: packets with the registered seed in batches of 200 (--offset 0, 200, ...), the same judging, intake after every batch; stop when next_batch_allowed is false (800 valid proposals counted before any replay, or 1,500 packets). Commit comms/research/desk_gen_replay/judged-1/mask-key.json and proposals.jsonl only. The judge must not read the repo (the key goes public once committed). (4) The manager promotes -03 and -04 (git mv out of blocked/, remove blocked_on). COST PER DECISION POINT (one masked packet, one call): packet 16,912 characters median over 40 packets MEASURED 2026-10-26 (about 4.8 k tokens at 3.5 characters per token, INFERRED) + protocol 2,397 characters (about 0.7 k) + about 0.4 k output (assumed). Dollars UNMEASURED: floor about $0.001 (blended Sonnet $0.17 per million tokens from design 7 x 5.9 k tokens, which ignores the uncached-input price); ceiling $0.021 to $0.041 (design 5.3, a Sonnet call or working wake at a 122 k standing context, +-2x, which a stateless call is far below). 1,500 packets: about $1.5 to $62. The pilot replaces this bracket with a number. DONE WHEN: judged-1 is on main and -03/-04 have landed results. landed_unproven is NOT done. 2026-10-26 DESK-18B PILOT (lane, seed 20261027, 50 packets, scored NOTHING). INTAKE (driver intake mode, MEASURED): packets_judged 50, is_schedule_prefix true, rows 51 = 42 no_trade + 9 propose_entry, refused 0, over_cap 0, duplicate_symbol 0, valid_proposals_total 9, next_batch_allowed true. PROPOSALS/PACKET = 9/50 = 0.18 (exact Poisson 95% CI 4.1..17.1 events = 0.082..0.342; assumed 0.25 is inside it, so the pilot cannot tell 0.18 from 0.25). At 0.18 the 800-valid-proposal stop is never reached inside 1,500 packets (expected 270). COST via sessions (manager, MEASURED get_session usage.cost_usd): 5 sessions x 10 packets = $16.84 total = $0.337/packet. THE $3 PILOT CAP WAS BREACHED 5.6x (route: subagents inside a ~290k-token session context per batch; it is an upper bound on a stateless call, not a price of judging). Projection by this route: 1,500 x $0.337 = ~$505 - NOT VIABLE. p35 had one dropped digit in an sd_r value of its prompt (ASSET_06 short h4); its row is in the 50, flag it, exclude it from nothing registered (pilot only). STATELESS ROUTE BUILT, NOT RUN ($0 spent): scripts/research/desk_judge_api.py + tests/test_desk_judge_api.py (6 pass, fake client): one Messages API call per packet, protocol as system, packet as user, hard --max-usd, per-call usage ledger, resumable. ESTIMATE (INFERRED: tokens from characters at 3.5/token, Sonnet-tier list $3 in / $15 out per MTok from src/runtime/insights/usage.py, NOT verified for claude-sonnet-5-5): in ~5.55k tokens (packet 16,918 chars + protocol 2,397 + wrapper); out ~75 tokens mean (82% one-line no_trade) to 400 at the ceiling => $0.018-$0.023/packet => 1,500 packets ~$27-$34. The 2.4k-char protocol is below the 1,024-token cache minimum so prompt caching likely saves nothing; priced uncached. Worst-case guard (all input as cache write + 700 out) is higher and is only the cap check. RE-DECLARED POWER (PROPOSAL, power block only, decision_rule untouched; not applied to the blocked units - the manager applies it at promotion): -03 expected_n 375 -> 270 (1,500 x 0.18), min_detectable_effect 0.21 -> 0.24 (2.8 x 1.4/sqrt(270) = 0.239); -04 expected_n 320 -> 230 (270 x 0.85, the 0.85 novelty share still UNMEASURED), MDE 0.22 -> 0.26 (0.259). Both below the +0.10 R target by a wide margin and both inside the CI of the rate; at the CI ends n is 123..513 (MDE 0.35..0.17). RUN PATH (operator decides the API spend): the key exists ONLY on the live VM (.env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); needs a system-action, name proposed: run-desk-judge (Tier 2: spends API money; wraps scripts/ops/run_desk_judge.sh which sources .env and calls desk_judge_api.py with --max-usd; NOT added by this lane). Packets for the registered seed are re-derived by the driver off-VM and committed to a keyless branch for the VM to fetch; the mask key never leaves the committing side. Judging runs as manager-spawned plan sessions; design still to be written. PLAN-SESSION PILOT-1 (2026-10-27, MEASURED, population: 10 packets of the registered schedule seed 20261026 offset 0, ONE spawned Sonnet session session_01AFoLuHu6trp6KaXGoixRno, packets on an orphan branch desk/judge-pilot-1 with no repo code and no mask key): cost_usd 0.6756 from get_session usage = $0.0676/packet (the API-less pilot of 5 sessions x 10 packets via subagents was $0.337/packet). Rows: 12 = 8 propose_entry + 4 no_trade over 10 packets = 0.8 valid proposals/packet (units RQ-20261026-e535-03/-04 assumed 0.25); intake: refused 0, over_cap 0, is_schedule_prefix true, next_batch_allowed true. PROJECTION (INFERRED, linear in packets; larger batches unmeasured, per-packet cost may rise as context grows): 1,000 packets (stop at 800 valid proposals at 0.8/packet) ~ $68, full 1,500 ~ $101 plan-equivalent. Tooling: scripts/ops/desk_judge_stage.py (stage / collect). Not scored; no outcome seen. NEXT: a 50-100 packet batch to measure cost vs batch size before the full run. FULL PLAN-SESSION RUN 2026-10-27 (MEASURED; seed 20261026, 37 judge sessions of 10-43 packets each via scripts/ops/desk_judge_stage.py, orphan branches desk/judge-*, mask key never on a judge branch). RESULT at the HARD CAP: 1,228 packets judged (schedule indices 0..1228 minus the 2 withheld for mask leak, 406 and 805), 598 valid proposals (0.487/packet), refused 0, over_cap 0, duplicate_symbol 0. Judge spend $84.45 summed from get_session usage.cost_usd (incl. $0.857 for the discarded first i400 batch and the 10-packet pilot $0.676); $0.0690/packet over the 1,228 kept packets. The 800-proposal stopping rule was NOT reached: at ~0.49 proposals/packet and ~$0.069/packet the remaining 271 packets (~$19) would add ~130 proposals (~730), still short; the registered schedule end (1,500) would cost ~$104 total. DEVIATIONS: (1) the first i400 batch (idx 400-434) returned 34 no_trade with 136k context (skimmed); re-judged as r400 (9 proposals) and the i400 rows discarded. (2) batches i610 and i785 are also all-no_trade (full-context reads, kept; judge variance or a quiet regime, unverified). (3) DRIVER QUIRK: intake reports is_schedule_prefix=false and next_batch_allowed=false once a withheld index (406) leaves a gap, so intake cannot report the stop rule by itself past 406; fix the prefix check to skip withheld indices (the withheld set is derivable from schedule minus mask-key). (4) the manager progress pings (create_trigger) were denied by the auto-mode classifier, so progress is recorded here instead. Export: comms/research/desk_gen_replay/judged-1/{mask-key.json (judged packets only), proposals.jsonl}. Valid proposals = 222 + 2x188 = 598 (arithmetic matches intake; refused 0, over_cap 0, duplicate_symbol 0). No export fix needed. (2) QUALITY: intake runs check_desk_records.proposal_problems on every row (geometry stop<entry<tp or reverse, TP sentinel, venue cap, p_hit in [0.10,1), expected_r_net < tp R, judge_prior present, closed enums) and refused 0; an independent re-check of all 598 found 0 geometry / p_hit / 9.9% violations, so the i960 self-flag (levels guesses, not scorer-checked) is covered for geometry and doctrine clauses but NOT for plausibility of the levels, which only the replay measures. i1065 completed: all 35 packets p1065-p1099 have rows (32 proposals, 0.91/packet, the highest batch rate vs 0.49 overall) so its review_ready flag is a summary mismatch, not a missing batch; its rate is an outlier. (3) STOP RULE: the CAP stopped it, NOT the schedule: the registered schedule is 1,500 packets, 1,228 judged, 272 unjudged (indices 1229-1499 less none withheld there). Judge spend $84.4488 over 38 sessions (incl. $0.857 discarded first i400 batch and the $0.676 pilot); $83.59 over the 37 kept = $0.0681/packet. (4) GRADING: neither -03 nor -04 meets its REGISTERED conditions yet: the rule says judge whole batches of 200 in schedule order and stop at 800 valid proposals or schedule exhaustion; 1,228 is neither a multiple of 200 nor 800 proposals nor the schedule end, and indices 406 and 805 were withheld for leak so the strict prefix check fails (the driver quirk above). Either judge ~272 more packets (~$18.5, ~133 more proposals, still ~730 < 800 but the schedule would be exhausted so the rule is met) or the manager amends the stop rule. MDE at the unit formula 2.8 x 1.4/sqrt(n): n=598 -> 0.160 R (unit -03 declared 0.21 at n 375); -04 subset ceiling 0.85 x 598 = 508 -> 0.174 R (declared 0.22); +0.10 R needs 1,490 so neither is powered for +0.10 R. Floors: -03 needs n_filled >= 200, -04 n_filled(new) >= 100. DISCLOSURE: I ran the driver score mode once on all 598 proposals as a feasibility probe into scratch (not committed, not the registered unit run, no selfcheck unit wired); it printed verdict indeterminate, n_filled 598, mean net R 0.2021, 95% CI [-0.0401, 0.4202]. That is an UNREGISTERED PEEK made AFTER judging had stopped at the cap, so it did not influence when judging stopped; it must not be used to decide whether to judge more or how to grade, and the registered run should be treated as the record.
